An Integration User is a dedicated full Salesforce license that has a custom Permission Set and is used for any 3rd party integrations. This can help reduce issues related to configuration, authorization, and individual employee user access. ::: ## Meet the New Welcome Mat! After installing/upgrading the {{variable.Product_Events}} app, you will see the Welcome Mat or in-app guidance on the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} page. Choose to dismiss the Welcome Mat, preventing it from loading when after navigating to the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} page, or select one of the following options: * Watch the Quick Set-Up video to learn how to configure the {{variable.Product_Events}} app. * See a pre-created {{variable.Object_Event}} example. * Create your own {{variable.Object_Event}} with the In-App guidance. * Read about configuring an Event on your own. * View the express tour. * Talk to our trial assistant.
